CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Use Balaam’s Donkey to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Balaam’s Donkey has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Balaam’s Donkey.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   C. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)

   D. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   B. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.
   C. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Patriarchs Abraham has no place in daily life.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Family Family members.

15. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Annunciation.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Annunciation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.
